label: 🌊 Rolling window
description: Add rolling-window aggregations (moving average, rolling sum, etc.) over a sorted time series. Common for smoothing noisy metrics or computing cumulative trends.

time_column.label: Time column
time_column.help: Sort by this before rolling. Optional — if blank, rolls over the existing row order.

windows.label: Windows
windows.help: List of {column, fn, window, as} where fn ∈ mean|sum|min|max|std|count and window is e.g. 7 (rows) or '7d' (time-based, requires time_column).

min_periods.label: Minimum periods
min_periods.help: Smallest number of observations needed to emit a value; below this, the rolling output is null.
